title: wedelia pinetorum
intro: Wedelia pinetorum, commonly known as Wedelia or Pineapple Weed, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is a herb that has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation, fever, and skin conditions, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wedelia pinetorum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia pinetorum include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
